props.name: data
props.description: The readings, oldest first, as the consumer's feed keeps them. A reading out of order sorts by time, and one instant holds one reading: of readings that share a time, the last wins, as a feed that corrects its latest reading sends it again. Keep at least the window's worth, and drop older readings as the feed grows: the chart draws only the window, and the table and the description cover the window back from the latest reading. Every cell is serialisable, so a server component passes it.
